title: Decoding a directed acyclic circuit
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, the decoder returns a pair consisting of a natural number $n$ and a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ input vertices exactly when $w$ parses successively as $n$, a list of gates, and an output index, the gates read only earlier vertices, the output is a vertex of the circuit, and encoding the resulting circuit reproduces $w$. In all other cases it returns no value.
